  "gitCommitMessage": "fix(android): always include src/oldarch in esc-pos-printer sourceSets\n\nPatch 1 in patchEscPosAndroidBuildGradle() had an inverted condition:\n\nFix: unconditionally add src/oldarch so that NativeEscPosPrinterSpec and\nNativeEscPosPrinterDiscoverySpec (package com.escposprinter, extending\nReactContextBaseJavaModule) are always available for Java compilation.\n\nThis resolves the compileDebugJavaWithJavac failure:\n  error: cannot find symbol: class NativeEscPosPrinterDiscoverySpec\n  error: cannot find symbol: class NativeEscPosPrinterSpec\n  error: incompatible types: EscPosPrinterModule cannot be converted to NativeModule\n\nRoot cause: com.facebook.react plugin was removed (Patch 2) to prevent the\nJNI codegen path in Android-autolinking.cmake from failing. Without the\nplugin, codegen does not run and the generated spec classes do not exist.\nThe oldarch stubs in src/oldarch/ supply equivalent abstract classes usable\nwith the old-arch NativeModules bridge (interop layer on RN 0.84).",
